**Class** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package. Inherits from [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/).

```csharp
public sealed class PrintCertificateException : PrintException
```

The exception thrown when a printer's certificate isn't trusted, so no encrypted connection to it was made.

A printer reached over IPPS usually has a certificate it made itself, which no certificate authority vouches for. To trust it, compare [PrintCertificateException.CertificateFingerprint](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printcertificateexception/#certificatefingerprint) with the fingerprint the printer's own web page or control panel shows, and if they match, add it to `IppNetworkOptions.TrustedCertificateFingerprints`. Because it derives from [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/), a `catch` for [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/) catches it too.

## Properties

### CertificateFingerprint

```csharp
public string? CertificateFingerprint { get; init; }
```

Gets the SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate that was refused, as colon-separated pairs of hexadecimal digits such as `3A:7F:...`, ready to add to `IppNetworkOptions.TrustedCertificateFingerprints`; or `null` if it isn't known.

### PrinterUri

```csharp
public Uri? PrinterUri { get; init; }
```

Gets the address of the printer whose certificate was refused, or `null` if it isn't known.
